scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend"
scripts.stop: lsof -ti:3000,3001 | xargs kill 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped all services'
